{{Quote|What the blazes are you doin' in my kitchen?|Pappi, to the freelance agents who entered his kitchen in pursuit of Xirossk|<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />}}
'''Pappi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Pappi gained employment as the head [[Chef/Legends|chef]] of ''[[Conkesta]]'', a floating [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] constructed by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. Following ''Conkesta''{{'s}} destruction, Pappi took a new job running the kitchen of a [[Burnout Cafetorium|cafeteria]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] in the [[Thaereian system]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Pappi encountered a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] and provided them information on the movements of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]] in return for the operatives' assistance in resolving some culinary challenges.

==Biography==
{{Quote|What's burning? Which of you IDIOTS let something burn in MY KITCHEN?|Pappi, to his kitchen staff at the Burnout Cafetorium|<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />}}
[[File:Genarius.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Genarius, the planet where Pappi worked on the fortress ''Conkesta'']]
Pappi was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] Pappi was in his late twenties,<ref name="Dates">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. In ''The Air Up Thaere'' it is stated that Pappi was in his late thirties during events of that roleplaying adventure; by the aforesaid rationale, he was therefore ten years younger during the events of ''Into the Storm Clouds'', in his late twenties.</ref> he took a post as the head chef of ''[[Conkesta]]'', an [[Armor/Legends|armored]], floating [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] built by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> Pappi worked in the kitchen of the fortress, alongside two other chefs.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

{{RPG|''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]''}}
A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance operatives]] infiltrated ''Conkesta'' on a mission to destroy the installation and passed through the kitchen as they progressed through the fortress,<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> encountering Pappi and his two chef colleagues.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />
{{Endgame}}

The freelance agents released a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] into the ''Conkesta'' main [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that caused the station to plummet into the planetary core of Genarius<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> and Pappi fled the station shortly before its destruction. He found a new job overseeing the kitchen of the [[Burnout Cafetorium]], the cafeteria of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] in the [[Thaereian system]] and led a kitchen staff of over twenty individuals, who were staunchly loyal to him.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

{{RPG|''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]''}}
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> while at work on Burnout Pappi became annoyed after the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Thaereian Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Xirossk]] burst in and ran through his kitchen. Xirossk had stolen a [[PU-36 modulator chip|key component]] from the same freelance agents that Pappi had previously encountered on ''Conkesta'' and the group entered the kitchen in pursuit of the Trandoshan. Pappi did not recognize the operatives from his previous run-in with them and angrily demanded an explanation for the agents' presence in his kitchen. In return for information on which way Xirossk had ran, the group assisted Pappi with enhancing the variety and volume of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that he prepared and with treating his allergy to the seeds of the [[Bothan pepper tree]]. As the freelance agents departed, Pappi berated his kitchen subordinates for burning some food.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Whose kitchen is this? Yours? I didn't think so. I'm a busy man.|Pappi, to the freelance agents who entered his kitchen in pursuit of Xirossk|<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />}}
A large man,<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> Pappi was an expert chef,<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> experienced in cooking with different methods and materials. He maintained tight control of the kitchens that he operated and did not tolerate "[[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]-brushing" among his employees, a term that he applied to fooling around while at work. He was quick to anger and became red in the face when riled. He possessed an allergy to ground Bothan pepper [[Tree/Legends|tree]] seeds which caused him to develop a runny nose and almost sent him into convulsions. Due to the popularity of the pepper among the Burnout inhabitants he was forced to use it as an ingredient in his cooking and consequently was keen to find a solution to his ailment.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

Pappi did not embark on his career as a chef for financial gain and sought respect for his culinary achievements. However, he was poor at math and encountered practical challenges in preparing the volume and variety of food needed to cater to the people of Burnout; he often served [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] meat and noted that it did not satisfy some of his diners. He was angered when he had to abandon his kitchen on ''Conkesta'' and later irked when Xirossk ran through his kitchen on Burnout, and was further annoyed when the freelance agents pursuing Xirossk approached the chef seeking information on the direction in which the errant Trandoshan had fled.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

==Equipment==
During his tenure on ''Conkesta'', Pappi wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] kitchen [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and a small [[Paper/Legends|paper]] hat,<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> and he donned similar garb while stationed on Burnout. He carried a [[Vibro-cleaver/Legends|vibro-cleaver]] cooking implement and when conversing with others in his kitchen on Burnout habitually tossed the cleaver into the air, then caught it.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pappi featured in [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying game, a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. He appeared in the [[2002]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'' by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]], the second instalment of the [[Looking In trilogy]], in which he was identified as one of three<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> unnamed<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> chefs that appeared in the<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> [[2001]]<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]'',<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> by Mullins and [[Jason Nichols]],<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> retroactively establishing ''Into the Storm Clouds'' as Pappi's first appearance.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />

In the ''Living Force'' campaign, the players roleplay as the group of individuals that infiltrate ''Conkesta'' and whom Pappi later encounters on Burnout.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> In ''Into the Storm Clouds'', it is possible for the player characters to pass through the kitchen of ''Conkesta'' as they progress through the fortress<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" /> and to encounter Pappi and his two colleagues.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> It is also possible for one ''Conkesta''{{'s}} three chefs accompany an elite strike force of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in attacking the player characters as they progress through the facility; it is however unclear whether this chef is Pappi.<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds" />

When the player characters encounter Pappi on Burnout when playing ''The Air Up Thaere'', if they players previously interacted within him on ''Conkesta'' he does not recognize them. The players can negotiate with Pappi for information regarding the direction in which Xirossk had fled; Pappi refuses to assist the unless the players support him in treating his Bothan pepper allergy and devising strategies to improve the diversity and amount of food that he produced. In addressing these demands, it is possible for the players to then provide Pappi with an electronic [[Book/Legends|cookbook]] detailing new recipes, to setup a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program to help calculate quantities of ingredients to use in his cooking and to design a treatment for his allergy. It is also possible for the player characters to engage him in combat.<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" />
